gallery.alt: Two flatbeds standing nose on across the gravel yard on a grey afternoon
Vintage step van, long off the road, carried away whole on the flatbed deck
Red flatbed wrecker carrying a saloon, the Briggs Towing name and number lettered across the door
Whole timber storage building loaded on the flatbed deck and eased down a driveway
Close on the door of the red wrecker with the company name and number filling the panel

reviews.author: Bryan Lewis
reviews.text: We called Briggs Towing at 4 AM and they answered right away and got to us quickly. Great service and very professional. Definitely recommend if you ever need a tow!

reviews.author: Pegi Campbell
reviews.text: My granddaughter had a blow out due to hitting a curb and it crushed rim. The donut was crap when we put it on and we needed the car towed. She called Briggs and they came right out. Chad had the car loaded and at our house in good time and also gave us a great lead on some new tires. We'll definitely recommend and use them in the future.

reviews.author: Kellie Garnett
reviews.text: Nothing good to say about this place at all. I was looking for a vehicle that got towed away cause it broke down in a church parking lot. The church gave me this places information so I called the place and the man was really rude. Cursed me out. Definitely not how you run a business. I understand the church made an innocent mistake and gave me the wrong place but no reason for someone to be so rude. Would definitely never give this place business. He definitely needs to learn how to talk to people.. Point blank. I been having a business for over 10 years and never raise my voice at a customer much less cursed at anyone. Disrespect at its finest!!
